mg.src: Youssef, FX6_LVH_6399 [00:31] “how peace can be achieved in the Middle East”

mg.title: Success is rare

text.main: success in this area is very rare and far apart

mg.use: Top band over him as he says it. Keep captions on.

mg.title: Work together

text.main: work together rather than fight each other.

mg.title: Include them

text.main: you still have to include them

mg.title: We can not give up

mg.title: Ready to fail

text.main: But those who are ready to fail time and again perhaps this is where they should focus their efforts.
